description: This file contains test helper functions and classes for certificate validation, including reading test data, parsing certificates, and verifying errors, primarily used in testing the certificate PKI components within Chromium.

classes.name: VerifyCertChainTest
classes.description: A class representing a test case for verifying certificate chains, including expected policies and errors.

methods.name: VerifyCertChainTest::HasHighSeverityErrors
methods.description: Checks if the test case has high severity errors based on expected error string.

methods.name: ReadCertChainFromFile
methods.description: Reads a certificate chain from a PEM file into a list of parsed certificates.

methods.name: ReadCertFromFile
methods.description: Reads a single certificate from a PEM file.

methods.name: ReadVerifyCertChainTestFromFile
methods.description: Reads and parses a test case configuration for certificate chain verification from a file.

methods.name: ReadTestFileToString
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a test data file into a string.

methods.name: VerifyCertPathErrors
methods.description: Compares expected and actual certificate path errors and reports mismatches.

methods.name: VerifyCertErrors
methods.description: Compares expected and actual certificate errors and reports mismatches.

methods.name: VerifyUserConstrainedPolicySet
methods.description: Verifies that the actual user-constrained policy set matches the expected set.
